newsitem.title: USA: Kanawha Cty, W.Va., plans $100 mln GO referendum.
newsitem.headline: Kanawha Cty, W.Va., plans $100 mln GO referendum.

text.p: West Virginia's Kanawha County is expected to call a special referendum in February 1997 to vote on a general obligation bond issue of about $100 million for schools, school Superintendent Jorea Marple said Monday.
The school board must set the final amount and work out other details by Dec 7, Marple said.
"We haven't finalized it but it will be about $100 million," she said.
She said maturities would range out 10 or 15 years.
The proposal would require an annual property tax increase of $118.20 on a $100,000 home if the bonds are repaid over 10 years, Maple said.
Bond proceeds would fund construction of two new schools, renovation and air conditioning and computer installation at several existing schools.
The issue would be the county'a first comprehensive bond issue in 30 years, Maple said.
